mission: Finish and ship video-identity matching: get the full suite green on Node 22, merge with the four commits already on origin/main, deploy to the live vidarr container, and confirm a live sync matches far more than 1 of 3,602 server videos. Merge and deploy need the user's renewed approval.
next_actions: Read-only orientation: git log, git status, docker ps, health check; change nothing.
In a scratch branch from origin/main, merge handoff/video-identity-matching, resolve CHANGELOG.md, and review the four upstream commits (517a857, 163cb36, 3004b07, 8041b97) as a PR.
Run the full build and tests on Node 22 in Docker with --testTimeout=60000 --hookTimeout=60000 on the command line; wait for exit=0.
Add the missing CHANGELOG entry (and product-vision note if behavior changes), then report to the user and re-confirm merge, deploy, and the record-deleting cleanup.
On approval, deploy with the documented procedure and verify with a live sync; do not push to origin/main unless the user says so.
